# Julien Simon - AI Operating Partner

> Julien Simon is an AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital with 30+ years of technology leadership. Expert in Small Language Models, enterprise AI implementation, and bridging AI research with practical business applications. #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021). 693+ speaking engagements across 37 countries, 583K+ YouTube subscribers, 505+ technical articles. Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing). Previously VP & Chief Evangelist at Arcee AI, Chief Evangelist at Hugging Face, and Global Evangelist for AI/ML at AWS.

Last updated: 2026-11-12

## Key Facts

- Current role: AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital (PE & VC)
- 693+ speaking engagements across 37 countries and 96 cities
- 583K+ YouTube subscribers, 462+ videos
- 505+ technical blog posts across AWS, Hugging Face, Medium, Arcee AI, and Substack
- Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing, 2 editions)
- #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021)
- Featured in "The 100 Shaping AI in Europe" (L'Opinion & Oliver Wyman, 2025)
- Arm Ambassador (2025)
- 30+ years technology leadership

## Primary Expertise

- Small Language Models (SLMs) — cost-effective, privacy-first enterprise AI
- Enterprise AI Implementation — practical deployment strategies for production
- Private Equity AI Strategy — portfolio company acceleration
- Cloud Computing — AWS (10 certifications), infrastructure optimization
- Open Source AI — Hugging Face ecosystem, open-weights models
- AI Hardware — inference optimization across CPU, GPU, and AI accelerators

## Podcast: The AI Realist

The AI Realist podcast is the audio edition of Julien Simon's newsletter on the AI industry. Each episode is one written piece, narrated by an AI voice. 14 episodes as of 2026-11-11.

- [Podcast page](https://www.julien.org/podcast): every episode, with a player and a link to the written piece
- [RSS feed](https://podcast.julien.org/feed.xml): audio, chapters and a WebVTT transcript for each episode
- [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/podcast/the-ai-realist/id6819758071)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/78U6RiqMDd0wnY3FmJFZGF)

Latest episodes:
- **Mistral Large 4: Where Did the 41 Go?** (2026-11-11, 13 min): Artificial Analysis removed the run behind Mistral's headline coding score. Mistral's release page, model card, and technical report still cite it. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/mistral-large-4-terminal-bench-41-removed
- **Mistral Large 4 Weights: The Score Comes With the Harness** (2026-11-01, 11 min): Mistral Large 4's weights landed October 29th, 2026. Its Terminal-Bench 41 comes from Mistral's own coding agent; in a generic agent it scores 25. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/mistral-large-4-weights-score-comes-with-harness
- **GeForce vs Workstation GPUs: NVIDIA's Half Rate, Priced** (2026-10-28, 15 min): NVIDIA sells one chip at two training speeds, and the unlocks prove it's a setting. Even capped, GeForce wins per dollar to buy. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/nvidia-geforce-half-rate
- **Exploring Apple's On-Device Model: Twenty Billion Parameters in Flash** (2026-10-25, 30 min): Apple Intelligence's 20-billion-parameter model lives in flash and wakes a few experts per prompt. Your Mac gains memory and battery, not math. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/exploring-apple-on-device-model
- **Ticking Boxes, Shipping Models: Doctolib, Amazon Web Services, Nvidia** (2026-10-15, 21 min): Doctolib ticks the health-data compliance boxes with US clouds and models. For now, its public promises say more than its documents show. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/ticking-boxes-shipping-models

## Blog Categories

- [Industry Perspectives](https://www.julien.org/blog/industry-perspectives/): 107 company-agnostic AI industry analysis articles (2021–present)
- [The AI Realist (Substack)](https://www.airealist.ai/): Long-form AI industry analysis — comparable to SemiAnalysis, Stratechery, and Import AI but from a practitioner who has built at AWS, Hugging Face, and across PE/VC portfolios. Covers EU AI regulation, infrastructure economics, CPU inference, Small Language Models, and AI geopolitics.
- [Arcee AI Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/arcee): 16+ articles on Small Language Models, model merging (2024–2025)
- [Hugging Face Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/huggingface): 23+ articles on transformers, NLP, model optimization (2021–2024)
- [AWS Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/aws): 68+ articles on SageMaker, AI/ML services (2018–2021)
- [AWS Medium Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/aws-medium): 182+ cross-published AWS technical articles on Medium (2017–2021)
- [Medium Articles](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/medium): Personal Medium articles on ML and cloud computing (2017–2021)
- [Legacy Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/legacy): 90 personal blog posts on AWS, Docker, MongoDB, Node.js, and more (2008–2016)
